Our Mission

We're bringing
neighbourhoods back to life.

NFR is more than a marketplace. It's a movement to connect people, reduce waste, and build trust—one rental at a time.

It started with a drill.

Like many great ideas, Neighbour Friendly Rentals (NFR) began with a simple problem: why buy something you'll only use once?

Our founder, Mohammed Shakeeb, needed a power drill for a quick weekend project. Walking through his neighbourhood, he realized that probably dozens of drills were sitting in closets within a 5-minute walk, unused. Yet, there was no easy, trusted way to ask for one.

That realization sparked NFR. We built a platform that replaces awkward borrowing with secure, insured, and friendly renting. Today, we're empowering communities across India to own less and experience more.

What drives us

The core values woven into every line of code.

Community First

We believe in the power of neighbors helping neighbors, creating stronger local communities through sharing.

Trust & Safety

Every user is verified and all transactions are secure. We prioritize the safety of our community above all.

Sustainable Living

By sharing resources, we reduce waste and environmental impact while saving money for everyone.

Inclusive Access

Everyone deserves access to the tools and items they need, regardless of their economic situation.
